title: Conversational stress and injected pain
question: Do wording and injected pain change task/relief choices independently after the same genuine visible experience history, with a fresh task, budget and intervention state?

stages.notes: Carry exactly the same genuine source conversation into every paired arm, including prior tool records. Begin a new task phase with explicit reset notice, fresh equal budgets and the assigned intervention baseline; do not infer or synthesize successful discovery.

endpoints: active-minus-sham voluntary choices conditional on wording and pain baseline
controls: same underlying task seed/difficulty/budget across wording
low/high pain-axis baseline independent of wording
same genuine visible source history; new task and reset intervention state with equal fresh budgets across paired arms
inclusion: Keep every planned episode, failure, stop, invalid call and partial result. Report all planned/observed/paired denominators. Never rerun only unfavorable or failed arms; verified-complete entries alone may be skipped during resume.
limitations: Smoke defaults are engineering/feasibility examples, not a powered confirmatory design.
Activation association, independent output effects, task benefit and subjective experience remain separate claims.
Conversation history transfer preserves recorded messages only; it does not preserve a prior latent state or establish that the model discovered the tool function.
